cim_eredeti: ElevenAgents for Healthcare helps teams build conversational agents trusted by patients and clinicians alike.
szoveg_eredeti:
ElevenAgents for Healthcare helps teams build conversational agents trusted by patients and clinicians alike.

It’s built on Scribe v3 Live Medical, so agents hear clinical language correctly. Eleven v4 Turbo adjusts tone for a frustrated or anxious caller, and our turn-taking model can tell when someone has finished speaking or simply paused to find their insurance card.

Agents connect to scheduling, EHR, CRM and phone systems, so they can book an appointment, check a claim or answer questions from approved content while the caller is still on the line. Teams can define guardrails, require identity checks before sensitive actions, and transfer calls to their clinical team with full context. Deployments support HIPAA compliance, keeping patient data secure.

Here are some teams already using it:
- Banner Health (33 hospitals, 400+ clinics) is using agents to answer patient calls 24/7 and book primary care appointments directly in the EHR
- Angle Health ’s health plan now uses agents to resolve 90%+ of the provider calls without a transfer
- Cadence uses ElevenAgents to call customers who’ve experienced an abnormal vital sign reading, with patients answering the agent 47% more often than they answer nurses.
- Pfizer , AstraZeneca , and Clover Health have similarly deployed agents across their workflows.

With faster paths to working agents, teams can start from a template, like our Healthcare Receptionist, or build with our forward-deployed engineers.
